Eyre’s effervescent production marvellously captures the show’s constantly bubbling wit with the help of Stephen Mear’s often dazzlingly inventive choreography.

cn.t: Richard Eyre's joyous revival wins widespread praise for its exuberant performances and detailed staging, though some find the second half sags and question whether this 1954 musical fully earns classic status.
